Thread-read: 6894560327 (the triage first touch, the only comment). Labels at the read: `bug`, `priority:p2`, `pm:queue`, `area:ai`, `domain:server`, unassigned.

## The question he was asked

His intake rule of 2026-11-16 for the `repo:objectstack#1` seat is 「除了前任的任务继续处理，后续只认领 p1 或者阻塞 p1 的任务」. A survey of the other open p1 and p2 cards found five p2 cards that a customer or a measured environment has run into, with no open upstream block. Their grade is the only thing that keeps the seat from claiming them. Which of them rise to p1?

The three options on the card, as he read them:

- 「按价值挑五张升 p1」: 「#34228 中文打印、#34332 金额大写、#34095 升级预览漏字段、#34038 新组织示例数据无负责人、#33824 AI 问数露内部名,排在现有 p1 之后做。」 (recommended)
- 「只升中文打印两张」: 「只放开 #34228 和 #34332,中文报价单、合同能正常打印出去。其余三张留在 p2,本席不能认领。」
- 「先不加」: 「本席先做完手上 9 张和待领 3 张 p1。这五张继续留在 p2,没有席位可以认领。」

## The ruling

**#34228, #34332, #34095, #34038 and #33824 are raised to p1 and may be claimed. They are taken after the p1 work already in hand, not ahead of it.**

Why this card was one of the five, as told to him: An AI data answer shows option values and API names (`urgent`, `in_progress`, `e9gv_ticket`) to a business user, so the answer reads like debug output. It was seen once, in the staging browser test of 2026-11-15.

The p2 on this card is triage's first-touch grade. This is his own later word on the card and sets the grade.

- This record changes no label. The grade write (`priority:p2` to `priority:p1`) is for the seat that takes the ruling, with this record as its Ruling-ref.
- Size was estimated from the card face only and was not measured.
- Survey: `/mnt/project-files/pm-orders/objectstack/value-survey-2026-11-16.md`.
- Knock: `Notify: ruling` to the `repo:objectstack#1` mailbox, PR #34367, and to the triage mailbox, PR #32588.

Re: decision · #33824 (p1, Ruling-ref 6918081689) · Ask source block scope · report 6918536912 · 2026-11-16T14:02Z

Seat route: **A.** Widen `ObjectQuerySourceSchema.scope` to a closed, required enum of two values. `'visible_to_you'` means a row restriction applied. `'all_records'` means `ISecurityService.getReadFilter(object, ctx)` answered `undefined` for this caller and object. "Filtered" here means a restriction applied, not that rows were counted as excluded.

A is the only option that meets both halves of acceptance 2 while keeping the access statement required and fail-closed. The console reader needs no edit. B fails open on an access statement when a producer omits the key, and narrows the "always present" promise. C leaves acceptance 2's restricted-member half unmet.

Declarations: `Clause-②: yes (widening)`. Metadata-protocol is read against `packages/spec/authorable-surface/ai.json`, which lists `ObjectQuerySource:scope`, so expect `added`. A minor spec changeset is needed, and an L2 at contract-review tier is owed before the queue. The PR touches `packages/spec`, so it is Tier H, and the maintainer reads this route at approval and can veto it there. This is not a maintainer ruling.

The cloud half goes to the cloud lane, carried by the report's first out-of-scope item: the `resultSourceBlock()` line from labels, option labels to the Ask tools, the prompt wording, and `scope` set per call from `getReadFilter`. This PR is `Part of #33824`. The card closes when both halves are delivered.
